beats.headline: Zockau burns
beats.text: At registration, a Syndicate liaison asks Carl to hand back the Gate of the Feral Gods, and Carl asks for a lawyer. The lawyer is Quasar, a Null who trades the Gate away for four free cretin mercenaries (Bomo, the Sledge, Clay-ton and Very Sullen) and two spells that copy its tricks: Bomo gets a jump to the stairwell, and the Sledge gets something called Zerzura that nobody explains. Carl takes the bomb specialisation, Agent Provocateur. Donut is a Legendary Diva whose spells only work if she sings them in key, and she cannot sing in key. Mordecai is a knee-high Pocket Kuma who has to jump to reach doorknobs. Katia and Chris leave with the caravans. Then, hours before the hunters are released, Bomo drops Carl and Donut on the stairwell steps in Zockau, the city where every hunter on the floor is waiting. Carl marks them with the Ring of Divine Suffering, kills them, and takes their stats. He lines a street of pubs with barrel bombs, and the Desperado Club's front comes down with hunters trapped inside. He gets out full of crossbow bolts and wakes in a cart pulled by Bianca, Prepotente's hellspawn goat, with Miriam Dom stroking his hair. She is a vampire now. Thirty-four hunters, and more than two hundred and fifty other casualties. It bothers him less than it should.

beats.headline: Point Mongo
beats.text: Every hunter Carl kills pays in gold and a severed hand, and the hands can be spent at the prize counter of the Butcher's Masquerade, a party the high elves throw at the floor's end for the top fifty crawlers. The ring leaves a spiderweb tattoo on his elbow, the mark of the Night Wyrm's cult, and something at the back of his mind has begun to rush like a river. Guilds go live. Hunter Vrah, a mantis who wears her kills' heads on her back and whose little sister Carl blew out of the sky in Zockau, pins a note to his door: the Hive is hunting him. Across the river, an ursine town bans dinosaurs, so Donut blows its mayor down a slope with Astral Paw, takes the town and renames it Point Mongo. Then Mongo bolts into the jungle with her on his back, straight to an all-female pack of his own kind led by a one-eyed matriarch called Kiwi, and settles the introductions in the obvious way. Back in town Donut breaks down. Everybody always leaves her: Miss Beatrice, Katia, now Mongo, and Carl keeps doing more dangerous things. Carl promises he will never leave her behind, on the ninth floor or any other. Quasar bargains a secret licence for Signet's show to continue past this floor. Then Signet herself walks out of the trees with a bound hunter across her caterpillar's saddle and a war party behind her.

beats.headline: Beatrice
beats.text: Signet's story, as she tells it: her naiad mother was murdered by a dissident Confederacy with high-elf help, and her half-sister Imogen now rules the high elves. She has gathered an army of were-castors, bush elves, a caterpillar sage and a tattooing tortoise to cut both of them out. Part one of Vengeance of the Daughter is to take Fort Freedom, the old river palace. A dead hunter's map shows the floor carved into hunting territories, and two outfits have put their claim on Carl and Donut: the Hive and the Skull Empire. Their third and last sponsor signs on, the Apothecary, a collective mind. Then they are pulled up to orbit for Odette's show, and she tells them Bea is alive. Bounty hunters were about to sell her to Borant to be made into a country boss, and Odette had her taken off the planet first and is using her to blackmail Borant. On the couch Beatrice appears drugged, thin and confused, asks why Carl isn't wearing pants, and is surprised the cat can talk. Off air Donut tells her she was going to sell her, and that she is not her person any more. Carl is. The moment the broadcast ends, a court makes Borant independent of its government, and the Valtay take fifty-one percent of it. Donut, it slips out, helped smuggle Valtay agents to Zev and something called the Borant Emancipation Front. Lexis warns them that Queen Imogen is a country boss built to wipe out the top of the leaderboard at the party.

beats.headline: Fort Freedom
beats.text: Katia finally leaves the party, though not the circle: the Royal Court joins Imani's guild, Safehome Yolanda, and Katia moves in next door with her own crew. Carl's fans vote him a booth at CrawlCon, which no active crawler has attended in a century. Elves from the Dream shell the town with a catapult. Carl straps missiles to Samantha's head and throws her at them, and marks one of their hunters, an accountant who won his place at fantasy hunter camp. The ring levels up. Donut takes a bracelet that casts Fireball, and Carl's anger is starting to scare her. Word comes that Langley and his whole team of archers are dead, their heads on Vrah's back. At Fort Freedom the Confederacy's defence is a joke, and Signet's amphibious team goes in the back while Samantha draws the guards to the front. What comes out of the throne room is a truck-sized eryops called Claude Sludgington the Fourth, with Samantha inside it. Carl's shell sends it straight up instead of sideways, Donut's fireball finds its belly, and Mongo eats his way out through the other side. The kill lands before the quest does, and the achievement is called Premature Questjaculation. Part two arrives: kill Queen Imogen at the Masquerade. The Recital quest names the thing that has been eating Point Mongo's neighbours. Big Tina, an allosaurus city boss in pink feathers.

beats.headline: CrawlCon
beats.text: Just as they reach the next village, Carl is pulled away to CrawlCon, leaving Donut in a town whose new mayor is Lucia Mar. He judges a children's drawing contest. The moderator of his panel is Circe Took, a hive queen, Vrah's mother and the mother of the hunter he killed. His own guards' vape smoke has been drugged. He puts his bare feet on the table, bores her on air, and when she tries to cut him off, a robed woman in the back row stops her: a spokeswoman for the Apothecary, his sponsor. Circe cleaves the table in half and storms out. Carl asks the audience how best to kill her daughter, and they tell him: seven warrior sisters, and a male who trades in Zockau. Back on the floor, Lucia has trapped the saferoom doors with teleports and Vrah's hunters are waiting outside. Carl comes back invisible, sets off every trap in town at once, and feeds Lucia a stuffed-cat decoy that makes her spring her own trap. A wheeled bomb kills three mantises, one of them tears her own sister apart, and Donut raises the heads on Vrah's back, Langley's among them, to bite her. Carl rams an arrow of Enthusiastic Double Gonorrhea into Vrah's neck. For her kind there are two cures: gelding, or passing it on. The last mantis on the floor, Edict, is a gentle accountant with no good choices left, and he punches Carl in a saferoom to be teleported away to die. The recap shows Donut's fight with Lucia: Lucia talking to an invisible youth assistant called Alexandro, and Donut dropping Cici's head through a hole in the floor.

beats.headline: Miriam
beats.text: At the autograph tables Carl's replacement sponsor is announced: the Plenty, the caprid collective. A naga reporter called Nihit tells him he is cheating, and Carl stabs him in the neck with a magical Sharpie. If Carl survives the crawl, that will mean a warrant, and a warrant can be sold. The Plenty and the Apothecary both send protection against vampirism on the same day. The next day Miriam Dom calls for help. Big Tina was an ursine child, the best dancer at a secret ballet recital, when the nine-tier attack came. Her cleric father had just beaten her mother on the stage for teaching it, and the attack turned the town's women into dinosaurs. Tina was the only child it changed. Tina's mother is Kiwi, and Tina's mind is gone. Miriam bit her in a fight with Viscount Fog, an elite vampire hunter, and now vampirism is spreading through every dinosaur in the forest. Carl fights his way to her through a vampire pterosaur boss, Fog's own mount, and finds her in a clearing, pinned under Prepotente's arm. He is paralysed and fragile, and in the fight his own Ring of Divine Suffering marked her: while she lives he cannot heal. She is the source of the plague. She asks Carl to kill her before Prepotente wakes. He will not. He waits with her until the sun comes up, and she dies with her head on her boy's frozen shoulder. Carl puts his own ring on behind his back as she goes, and takes three points of intelligence from her death. Donut wakes Prepotente, who screams at what is left of her and swallows his ring. A world quest follows: fifty Odious Creepers, dead by sunset.

beats.headline: Brambles
beats.text: Donut charms Kiwi with a potion, and Carl works out that the Plenty arranged Miriam's death to protect Prepotente. The guilds hunt creepers with Mordecai's weedkiller: Louis sprays it from the flying house, Carl lobs it with a stolen elven trebuchet, and Prepotente kills ten. Then the queen's familiar appears in a curtained litter, promises Donut a dance at the Masquerade, and fires lightning at Mongo. Donut takes it for him. It is Ferdinand. The last two creepers sit in Zockau, where only the hunters can reach them, so the quest fails, and the punishment is Gehenna Bramble: walls of thorns that boil the blood, spreading across the floor at four and a half kilometres an hour. Saferoom time must now be earned by killing. A drunk hunter teleported into Carl's lap says the AI is ignoring court orders and going primal, and the ring levels again. Carl works out that the brambles will finish covering the map at the high elves' castle at the floor's last minute. Circe Took has sponsored the god Diwata, and Carl's other sponsor, the pacifist network, slips him a potion for Donut. He bribes her to take it with a nipple ring, and pierces his own first. Then Quasar's real plan comes out. Zerzura moves a whole town, NPCs and all, one floor down, and the Hump Town changelings and Bonnie need to be inside a town when the Sledge casts it. The only town left standing is the castle.

beats.headline: The Butcher's Masquerade
beats.text: Orren the liaison has Carl brought in, clumsily warns him that some liaisons disagree with their own governments, and lets Quasar in to talk. The guild raids hunters to thin them before the party. Carl kills a worshipper of his own god by accident and wears Shunned over his head. Diwata bursts out of a hunter, marks Carl for death and runs straight past him to Vrah, to cure her in the only way that works. Five Apothecary boxes addressed to Donut arrive through other crawlers: a tiara, sheet music, a hammer, a metal rod, a recharge scroll, each marked with a small seven, as if they expect everyone else to be dead. Carl lies to Signet that her assault must wait for his signal. Then the party begins. The castle is a white cube of carved oak, which Elle calls the Sugar Cube. Imogen appears in their carriage with Ifechi's face. She is Ifechi's twin, remade as a country boss. The whole Masquerade sits under Apito's celestial peace seal: whoever breaks it is fed to the Nothing, and if nobody does, the queen earns a goddess's boon. In the ballroom Empress D'nadia judges the contests, Chaco runs the prize counter, Vrah promises a present, and Katia has to be held back from Eva. Lucia sits against a wall chewing her nails. Then Signet walks in. Apito herself invited her, as a test for her sister, and she says no host has ever won that boon.

beats.headline: The seal breaks
beats.text: Chaco, who regrets whatever he did to Mordecai, sells Carl a shrink wand, a lore book and a case of Feather Falls for his hunters' hands, and warns him that this place always makes you turn on your own party. Mongo moonwalks for the judges. Florin tells the others there are several people in Lucia's head, some of them children, and that the dog is the key. Donut charms Ferdinand into her party. Imogen comes in with blood down her gown: Gideon and nearly thirty crawlers waiting in the trees are dead because Carl asked them to wait there. Prudence is dead outside. The mantises have taken the flying house. Donut sings her mother's song, All Eyes on Me, and every creature in the room is charmed. Big Tina dances at last, with thirty velociraptors in paper sea-creature costumes behind her. Then Signet opens her own throat. Her blood wakes her tattoos for good, the floor opens and the Nothing takes her, and the seal is broken. The Sledge finishes Zerzura, and the whole castle goes to the ninth floor with the changelings, Bonnie, Tina, and Kiwi, whom Donut's potion has turned back into a pregnant bear her daughter finally recognises. Everyone else drops into a cage fight under a dome of thorns while Thunderstruck plays. Mongo and Kiwi bring down Vrah. Donut's Laundry Day strips the god off Circe Took, and her own children eat her. Imogen falls. So do Firas, Gwen, Horton and the Popov brothers, who split into two babies and are carried out of the dungeon to safety. Katia finds Eva alive under the bugs and kills her, and Eva's last act is to put the Crown of the Sepsis Whore on Katia's head. Now only one of Katia and Donut can leave the ninth floor. Donut's fans have bought the Royal Court a seat in Faction Wars, and Carl uses the last of his airtime to tell the galaxy how to vote.
